## What changed

Describe the change clearly and concisely.

## Why

Which capstone requirement, project task, bug or team need does this support?

## Files / areas affected

List the main folders or files changed.

## Validation

Describe what was actually checked, run or reviewed. Do not claim tests or execution that did not happen.

## AI assistance

If AI materially contributed, record the tool and purpose briefly.

## Risks / assumptions / follow-up

Note anything reviewers should know before merging.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change is understandable and focused.
- [ ] It does not overwrite unrelated teammate work.
- [ ] No project data, secrets or credentials were added unintentionally.
- [ ] Results or claims are supported by actual outputs.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] AI-assisted work has been reviewed and understood by a team member.
